description: Visitor flow contract v1. resolve: configuration in, the document db_core_visitor_flow_json returns out (revision and node-local image paths aside), plus the verdict of the write-time validator. walk: inputs to a shell-side walker over a resolved document, the Core calls each input causes, and what is on screen afterwards.
